title: 'Saliba will have minutes in next few Arsenal games', confirms Arteta
subtitle: FotMob
paragraphs: NewsAbout'Saliba will have minutes in next few Arsenal games', confirms ArtetaShareWilliam Saliba is yet to appear for Arsenal this season, but the defender is ready to make his comeback for the Gunners.Mikel Arteta has confirmed Arsenal defender William Saliba "will have minutes in the next few games" after missing the start of the season through injury.
Saliba has been sidelined for the entirety of 2026-27 so far, having suffered a back injury during France's World Cup semi-final defeat to Spain in the summer.
The Gunners have not struggled much in the centre-back's absence, partly due to the arrival of Ezri Konsa, but they should still be boosted by his return.
Saliba won possession more often than any Arsenal defender in the 2025-26 season, in which the Gunners won their first Premier League title in 22 years and reached the Champions League final.
The Frenchman also won the second-most duels (198), won the third-most tackles (35) and recorded the third-most interceptions (29).
While Arteta did not clarify whether Saliba would feature this weekend against Manchester City, he has revealed the defender will be back in action soon.
"He hasn't played football for a long time, he can play a certain amount of minutes," said Arteta about Saliba.
"He's training well, and he will have minutes in the next few games. And he will prove what he's already done, that he's an unbelievable player.
"Now he's had more training that [minutes available] will probably extend, but it will depend on the type of game and exposure that he will have throughout the game.
"He understands the situation, he's just desperate to play, that's for sure."
One Arsenal player who could miss out against City is goalkeeper David Raya.
The Spain international missed the Gunners' Champions League encounter with Borussia Dortmund on Tuesday after suffering an injury against Newcastle United last Saturday.
When asked about Raya's availability, Arteta said: "I don't know, we still have a few hours before the game. So, we're just trying to get everybody back."
